build_priority_thread_pool: build a PriorityThreadPoolExecutor with max_workers to prioritize downstream pipeline stages over upstream ones
build_priority_process_pool: build a PriorityProcessPoolExecutor with max_workers to prioritize CPU-bound downstream pipeline stages over upstream ones
create_stage_executor: create a per-stage executor with pool.get_executor(priority=N) to set explicit priority for a pipeline stage
submit_task_with_priority: submit a callable to a PriorityExecutorEntrypoint that executes with automatic priority ordering via the counter
shutdown_priority_pool: shutdown a PriorityThreadPoolExecutor or PriorityProcessPoolExecutor with wait and cancel_futures options
